description: The fastest, cheapest, most efficient open-source agent harness. Run more than 500 agents on a $10 VPS.
summary: OpenHuman is a Rust agent harness that shares one process across a whole fleet and compresses context between calls, which is the same scheduling problem I'm chewing on in PenguPool but with a much more aggressive per-agent memory budget. The "500 agents on a $10 VPS" headline is marketing spin, but the underlying trick of not respawning a heavyweight process per session and not resending the full prompt every turn is exactly the kind of toil removal I care about. What I'd actually want to poke at is the Rust library API: if the session scheduler and token-compression layers are clean, it's a useful building block for routing agent work across cheap hardware without babysitting a dozen Node processes.
